description: A split button: the left part runs the default action (an OnClick event, or a link when Url is set) and the chevron opens a menu of other actions that the screen puts in the Menu placeholder.

inputs.name: Label
inputs.description: The action button's text: verb-led, sentence case, one to three words.

inputs.name: Variant
inputs.description: The look. Primary and Secondary are OutSystems UI's btn-primary and btn; Tertiary and Transparent are styled by this component with OutSystems UI variables. Any other value uses Primary.

inputs.name: Size
inputs.description: The height: Medium is OutSystems UI's default button, Small is btn-small, ExtraSmall is this component's own. Any other value uses Medium.

inputs.name: Enabled
inputs.description: False disables both parts and closes the menu.

inputs.name: Url
inputs.description: When set, the action button is a link to this URL and OnClick isn't raised. Empty makes it a button that raises OnClick.

inputs.name: Icon
inputs.description: An optional leading icon: a Font Awesome 4 icon name, as in an OutSystems Icon widget (for example th-large). Empty shows none.

inputs.name: MenuLabel
inputs.description: The chevron's name for screen readers. Translate it like any other label.

events.name: OnClick
events.description: Raised when the action button is clicked and Url is empty. Do the default action here.

modifiers.description: Opens the menu aligned to the button's end edge, for a button at the end of a row.

placeholders.name: Menu
placeholders.description: The menu's actions: Links (an Icon and a Text inside each), each with its own On Click. It opens from the chevron and closes on a choice, Escape or a click outside.
